headline: OMNITUBE 1.5: cheaper cloud videos, your own style and watermark, publish from the app
notes: Pacing Fast, Normal or Calm: reuse each picture as a close-up and a pan, up to 3x cheaper cloud videos
Full cost estimate before every cloud build, the real amount spent after it, and an optional stop at 20% over
My styles: make your own picture style from words or from 1 to 6 example pictures
Characters speak in their own voices: write their lines as @Name: on their own line
New offline voices: Spanish, Hindi, Portuguese, French and Italian, plus more Spanish and Portuguese online voices
Pro: your own watermark (logo or channel name) on every video, Short and editor export
Pro: publish or schedule to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram through your Upload-Post account
Pro: fal.ai account, OpenRouter voices, and automatic switch to your next account if one fails
Pro: use OMNITUBE from Claude, and move Pro to a new PC yourself (works offline for up to 14 days)
New How to use page with every option explained, plus clearer messages when memory is low or a card is too old
